notes.title: Added "Head Bobbing" setting
notes.content: You can turn the head bobbing setting on or off in settings.

notes.title: FIX
notes.content:
Dear players! 🎮 We've been hard at work enhancing your horror gaming experience. Here are the updates:

1- Improved the visibility of interactive objects for smoother interaction.

2- Addressed player concerns by adding supplementary lights for an overall brighter gaming experience.

3- In the forest, directional signboards were introduced under the lights to ensure players don't get lost.

4- Identified and fixed glitches disrupting the game. (Note: If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out. You can reload and replay the current map.)

5- Made adjustments to a few jumpscares for an even more thrilling experience.

Update your game now and let us know your thoughts!
